title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Build and test backend services for a student-focused web platform. Work with engineers on APIs, data models, and reliable integrations.
eligibility: Students pursuing Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description: Develop features across a React interface and Python API. Help improve an online marketplace used by university communities.
eligibility: Open to undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Prepare datasets, evaluate prediction models, and communicate findings with the product team. The team builds practical analytics tools.
eligibility: Students with coursework or projects in machine learning or data science.

title: Data Analytics Intern
description: Analyse operational data, create dashboards, and write clear reports for business teams. This role focuses on data quality and insight generation.
eligibility: Open to students in engineering, statistics, economics, or related disciplines.

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: Assist with secure API development, database queries, and automated tests for cloud workflow software.
eligibility: Computer science or related students with programming project experience.

title: Frontend Developer Intern
description: Create accessible web interfaces for learning tools and collaborate with designers to turn product ideas into responsive pages.
eligibility: Open to students with frontend projects or a portfolio.
